glosses.notes: Describes something modern or of the present age, often in life, design, or technology.

example_translations.translation: Modern life is very convenient now.
This house looks very modern now.
Modern technology is developing quickly.

glosses.notes: Refers to physical money in bills or coins, as opposed to paying by card or phone.

example_translations.translation: This shop now only takes cash.
I did not bring cash today.
You can pay in cash now.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to reality or the real situation, often in contrast with ideas, hopes, or imagination.

example_translations.translation: Reality is not the same as movies.
We now have to face reality.
He finally accepted the reality of the situation.

glosses.notes: Used for a visible fact, pattern, or phenomenon that people can notice and discuss.

example_translations.translation: This is a very common phenomenon.
This phenomenon is very common now.
The teacher explained this phenomenon.

glosses.notes: Can mean a line, a wire, or a piece of thread depending on the context.

example_translations.translation: This line is already too long.
The computer cable has already come loose.
Mom uses thread to mend clothes.

glosses.notes: Often used in the pattern 和…相比 to compare one thing with another.

examples.sentence: 和以前相比，这里安静多了。

example_translations.translation: Compared with last year, this year is busier.
Compared with before, it is much quieter here.
Compared with my older brother, I look more like Mom.

glosses.notes: Usually works as an adverb meaning quite or fairly, showing a fairly high degree.

example_translations.translation: This book is quite interesting.
He came fairly early today.
This question is quite important.

glosses.notes: Describes something that has a connection with a topic, person, or issue.

example_translations.translation: This issue is related to money.
I already asked all the related questions.
The teacher is looking for related information.

glosses.notes: Shows a mutual action or relationship between two sides.

example_translations.translation: We should help each other now.
We need to understand each other now.
They glanced at each other.

glosses.notes: Describes two or more things that are alike in appearance, form, or nature.

example_translations.translation: These two photos are very similar.
These two pieces of clothing are very similar.
These two problems are somewhat similar.

glosses.notes: Describes a pleasant smell, and it can also describe food that smells delicious.

example_translations.translation: These flowers smell really fragrant today.
This soup smells great today.
The bread just came out and smells great.

glosses.notes: The common everyday word for a banana.

example_translations.translation: I already ate a banana this morning.
There are still many bananas on the table.
This banana is sweet.

glosses.notes: Often refers to spending money or consumer spending in daily life or the economy.

example_translations.translation: Spending here is not too high.
Travel spending is not low.
Recently everyone has been careful with spending.

glosses.notes: Means to disappear from sight or no longer be present.

example_translations.translation: That bird disappeared all of a sudden.
He disappeared right away.
After daybreak, the stars disappeared.

glosses.notes: Can mean a piece of news, a bit of information, or a message someone receives.

example_translations.translation: I just got good news.
If there is any news, please tell me right away.
Is this message true?

glosses.notes: Refers to the result or effect produced by a method, medicine, action, or effort.

examples.sentence: 新药的效果已经不错了。

example_translations.translation: This method works very well.
The new medicine is already working pretty well.
This round of practice had a very good result.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to writing as a skill or activity, especially composition or written expression.

example_translations.translation: She really likes writing.
The teacher asked us to practice writing.
This book teaches writing methods.

glosses.notes: The ordinary word for blood.

example_translations.translation: There is a little blood on his hand now.
There is blood on this piece of clothing now.
The child cried after seeing blood.

glosses.notes: Often refers to the heart, mind, or inner feelings rather than just the physical organ.

examples.sentence: 听到这个消息，他心里很难过。
听了妈妈的话，我心里放心了。

example_translations.translation: I feel very happy inside now.
He felt very sad when he heard this news.
After hearing Mom's words, I felt relieved inside.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it means to believe something or trust what someone says.

example_translations.translation: I believe what you are saying now.
This time I still do not believe it.
If you do not believe it, you can ask him.

glosses.notes: The paper cover used for letters or documents.

example_translations.translation: There are two envelopes here now.
Please put the photo into the envelope.
This envelope is too small now.

glosses.notes: Can refer to trust in a person or trust as a relationship that takes time to build.

example_translations.translation: I have always trusted him.
The teacher trusts this student.
Trust needs time.

glosses.notes: Refers to the bags and cases someone carries while traveling.

example_translations.translation: Your luggage has already arrived.
He has never brought much luggage.
The luggage is too heavy, so I will help you.

glosses.notes: Means to form, come into being, or gradually take shape.

examples.sentence: 这个新的习惯已经形成了。
大家的意见慢慢形成了。

example_translations.translation: Good habits take time to form.
This new habit has already formed.
Everyone's opinions gradually took shape.

glosses.notes: Refers to an outward form, structure, or format.

examples.sentence: 课上可以用小组形式讨论。

example_translations.translation: The competition format is very simple now.
This is only a formality.
In class, you can discuss in small-group format.

glosses.notes: Can refer to a person's or organization's image, or to the image of a character.

examples.sentence: 公司想改变自己的形象。

example_translations.translation: Personal image is important now.
This image looks very cute now.
The company wants to change its image.

glosses.notes: The common word for the shape or form of an object.

example_translations.translation: What shape is this thing?
The shape of this cloud is very unusual.
The shape of the star is very special.

glosses.notes: Describes a state of happiness, especially a happy life or feeling.

example_translations.translation: Being with your family feels wonderful.
A simple life can be very happy too.
I hope you will always be happy.

glosses.notes: Describes good luck or a fortunate situation.

examples.sentence: 我们都觉得自己很幸运。

example_translations.translation: I am very lucky today.
We all feel very lucky.
He luckily found the wallet.

glosses.notes: This bound form appears in words such as 个性 and 性别, where it marks a trait, quality, or category.

example_translations.translation: This child has a very distinct personality.
When personalities differ, ideas differ too.
The school asked about our gender.

glosses.notes: Refers to a person's gender.

example_translations.translation: You need to write your gender on this form.
Gender is not the main point now.
Gender is not written here.

glosses.notes: Describes someone's personality or character.

examples.sentence: 她的性格很好，大家都喜欢她。

example_translations.translation: She has a very nice personality, and everyone likes her.
My personality is rather quiet.
Even with different personalities, people can still be friends.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it means to repair or fix something that is broken.

example_translations.translation: My car is still being repaired now.
This phone has been fixed.
Dad is fixing the door today.

glosses.notes: Means to change, revise, or correct something so it becomes better or more suitable.

example_translations.translation: The teacher asked me to revise the composition.
This sentence needs revision now.
I have already finished revising it now.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to people's needs or to demand in society or the market.

example_translations.translation: Different people have different needs.
Market demand is getting bigger and bigger.
The school will consider students' needs.

glosses.notes: A very common verb for needing something or requiring something.

examples.sentence: 你要是需要我，就给我打电话。

example_translations.translation: I need help now.
This job requires experience.
If you need me, then call me.

glosses.notes: Means to announce or declare something publicly.

example_translations.translation: The teacher announced that there will be a test tomorrow.
The company just announced a new plan.
The competition result has already been announced.

glosses.notes: Often means to promote, publicize, or spread information about something.

example_translations.translation: The school is publicizing the new activity.
They use posters to promote the competition.
This movie was promoted very well.

glosses.notes: Refers to a contestant or player taking part in a competition.

examples.sentence: 观众都在等最后一位选手。

example_translations.translation: Both contestants are very young.
This contestant performed very well.
The audience are all waiting for the last contestant.

glosses.notes: Refers to the money paid for education or study at a school.

example_translations.translation: The tuition at this school is not low.
Dad paid my tuition.
Can the tuition be paid in two parts?

glosses.notes: Can refer to training as an activity or to the act of training.

example_translations.translation: He is training every day now.
This training session is hard now.
After training, she improved quickly.

glosses.notes: Means to press, push down, or hold something down with force.

example_translations.translation: He is pressing the paper down with his hand now.
This book is holding the paper down.
A stone is pressing down that photo.

glosses.notes: Can refer to pressure from work or study, or to mental stress.

example_translations.translation: Work pressure has been very high lately.
Do not put too much pressure on yourself.
A little pressure is not bad either.

glosses.notes: Can mean smoke in the air, and it can also mean cigarettes in everyday contexts such as buying or selling them.

example_translations.translation: There is smoke everywhere here now.
He went out to buy cigarettes.
This shop does not sell cigarettes.

glosses.notes: Can describe what is right in front of one's eyes or the present situation one should handle first.

example_translations.translation: The mountain in front of us is very beautiful now.
Let us first do what is right in front of us.
The opportunity right in front of us is important.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it means to act, perform, or play a role.

example_translations.translation: Today he is playing a teacher.
This time I will play the mother.
She acted very well on stage.

glosses.notes: Usually means to perform a song in front of an audience.

example_translations.translation: She is singing now.
She often sings at evening parties.
He is singing old songs now.

glosses.notes: Refers to a live concert performance, especially a singing concert.

example_translations.translation: We are going to a concert tomorrow.
This concert was very successful.
This concert starts at eight.

glosses.notes: Refers to a stage performance or show.

example_translations.translation: They have a performance today.
This performance is wonderful.
I have already seen her performance.

glosses.notes: Refers to an actor or performer on stage or on screen.

example_translations.translation: She wants to be an actor now.
This actor is very famous now.
The actor has already gone on stage.

glosses.notes: The usual word for a sheep.

example_translations.translation: There are many sheep on the mountain now.
That sheep keeps eating grass.
The lamb is following its mother now.

glosses.notes: Refers to sunshine or sunlight.

example_translations.translation: Today's sunshine is great.
Sunlight is shining on the table now.
It is warmer when there is sunshine.

glosses.notes: A common way to introduce a condition, similar to if.

examples.sentence: 要是你没空，我们明天再见。
要是你愿意，可以跟我一起去。

example_translations.translation: If you are not free, we will meet tomorrow.
If it rains, I will not go.
If you are willing, you can go with me.

glosses.notes: The rack or hanger used for hanging clothes.

example_translations.translation: The clothes hanger is behind the door now.
Please hang the coat on the hanger.
This hanger is a little small now.

glosses.notes: Refers to all things in general.

example_translations.translation: Everything will get better.
I want to forget everything now.
Everything is going according to plan.

glosses.notes: A formal written adverb meaning already.

example_translations.translation: The match has already started.
He has already gone home today.
It is already getting late.

glosses.notes: Used after a time point to mean since that time.

examples.sentence: 回国以来，她一直很开心。

example_translations.translation: Since this year began, he has been very busy.
Since school started, I have improved a lot.
Since returning home, she has been very happy.

glosses.notes: Usually appears in a balanced structure to present two sides or two simultaneous actions.

examples.sentence: 她一方面上班，一方面照顾孩子。
我们一方面学习，一方面练习。

example_translations.translation: On the one hand she works, and on the other hand she takes care of the child.
On the one hand we study, and on the other hand we practice.
On the one hand he listens, and on the other hand he writes.

glosses.notes: Refers to art in general, including music, painting, and other creative forms.

example_translations.translation: She likes art very much now.
Music is also a form of art.
This is also a kind of art.

glosses.notes: Can be a noun meaning accident or an adjective/adverb meaning unexpected.

example_translations.translation: This was only a small accident.
This result feels very unexpected.
He unexpectedly won first place.

glosses.notes: Refers to meaning, value, or significance.

examples.sentence: 我明白这件事的意义了。

example_translations.translation: This book is very meaningful.
I now understand the significance of this matter.
There is no point in doing this.

glosses.notes: A formal connector used to show a result, meaning therefore or so.

examples.sentence: 今天下雨，因此比赛取消了。
他一直很努力，因此进步很快。
这条路很远，因此我们早点出发。

example_translations.translation: It is raining today; therefore, the match was canceled.
He has worked hard for a long time; therefore, he has improved quickly.
This road is long, so we are leaving earlier.

glosses.notes: Refers to silver as a metal or material.

example_translations.translation: This watch is made of silver now.
That cup is not made of silver.
He wants to buy a silver watch.

glosses.notes: The medal for second place in a competition.

examples.sentence: 她只差一点就得了银牌。

example_translations.translation: He finally won the silver medal.
This silver medal is very beautiful.
She missed getting the silver medal by just a little.

glosses.notes: Refers to the feeling or impression that someone or something leaves on a person.

examples.sentence: 第一次见面，她就给人很好的印象。

example_translations.translation: He made a very good impression on me.
This city left a deep impression on me.
At our first meeting, she immediately gave people a very good impression.
